findings: HIGH — BhStatusChip uses only light-mode status token pairs. All six kDarkStatus*Bg/Fg tokens in app_tokens.dart are unused. Status chips will render low-contrast light pastel backgrounds on dark surfaces. Fix: pass Brightness to _resolve() and switch token sets on isDark.

MEDIUM — AppTheme.light and AppTheme.dark both declare fontFamily: 'Inter' in their TextTheme, but pubspec.yaml has no fonts: section. Flutter silently falls back to the OS system font. Either bundle the Inter font assets and declare them in pubspec, or remove the fontFamily references until the font is available.

MEDIUM — BhAppBar hardcodes kBorderSubtle (Color(0xFFF1F3F2), near-white) as the bottom border color in both light and dark themes. The separator is invisible in dark mode. Fix: use isDark ? kDarkBorderSubtle : kBorderSubtle.

LOW — _ScanPlaceholder uses a raw AppBar instead of BhAppBar. The 1px bottom border applied by BhAppBar via its own shape parameter is absent, creating a visual inconsistency on the scan route during dark-mode testing. Fix: replace AppBar with BhAppBar(title: 'Scan Parcel').
